summary: One-student Diamond warm-up stack: keep the fast clean Diamond basin, activate broad per-source exact sourceTopK/global-swap, export cumulative hot footprint, and consume it with hot-frontier selected reorder before optional continuation consumers.
use_when: Large row-rich/control/datapath case has little true macro evidence, Diamond is fast/clean, improve placement has broad recovery room, and sourceTopK/global-swap is absent, gated, or weak.
avoid_when: Do not use as a late closure-only route. If the exact producer, cumulative handoff, and selected reorder are already live and the only missing link is residual frontier conversion, query Blueprint A continuation instead.
mechanism_roles: start_basin:diamond
producer:full-source per-source top-K exact sourceTopK/global-swap
handoff:cumulative accepted footprint plus old/new hot segments
consumer:hot-frontier selected-segment reorder with bounded fallback
post_consumer:optional exact closure or critical-frontier continuation after core evidence
compatible_with: Blueprint A continuation after sourceTopK and cumulative handoff are live
stacking_notes: Implement producer, handoff, and selected-reorder consumer in one coherent route before adding heavy continuation consumers.
Use full-source traversal with small ranked per-source candidate pools, exact-probe caps, gain-rate stops, and tryMove before trySwap.
Many exact accepts with a one-node or two-segment surviving frontier is a handoff-lifetime failure, not a completed consumer.
done_criteria: SourceTopK/global-swap exact producer has nonzero accepted delta
cumulative native hot-segment handoff survives into the consumer
selected-segment reorder probes and accepts over the hot frontier or reports a named failure bucket
final HPWL movement is attributed to the core chain or the first missing link is named

summary: Post-producer critical-frontier continuation stack: consume already-live sourceTopK/global-swap accepted state through native frontier export, micro-start, critical-net chain, exact closure, multi-row residual transactions, and segment-local residual swaps.
use_when: Exact sourceTopK/global-swap accepts and cumulative hot/accepted frontier are already live, but final HPWL still has a residual hot/critical frontier after improve placement.
avoid_when: Do not assign standalone Blueprint A when the sourceTopK producer is absent, gated, tiny, or only telemetry-live; use Blueprint D+A or D first.
mechanism_roles: producer:already-live sourceTopK/global-swap accepted nodes or critical hot segments
handoff:native critical-frontier and accepted-node export
consumer:critical-row micro-start, critical-net chain, exact local closure
post_consumer:multi-row residual transaction and segment-local residual swap
stacking_notes: Use A as continuation on top of a live broad producer, not as a substitute for producer activation.
If local closure alone moves little HPWL, add the first missing chain link instead of retuning closure caps.
Promotion requires final HPWL preservation, not just accepted-delta liveness.
done_criteria: Producer liveness is already proven before the continuation is judged
consumer counters are nonzero and tied to the exported frontier
review classifies the result as full-chain, partial-chain, or non-live

summary: Negotiation recoverability plus endpoint/source exact consumer stack: rebuild a recoverable negotiation-like producer, source-edge exact global swap, hot-segment reorder, micro-pack, accepted-window replay/cascade, and endpoint/source target repair.
use_when: Endpoint/source residue on high-span nets is visible and a negotiation or NBLG-like legal basin can produce recoverable top-net payload for exact DPO consumers.
avoid_when: Do not use when the plan only changes negotiation weights, when handoff metadata is passive, or when endpoint/source residue is not the named payload.
mechanism_roles: start_basin:default_negotiation
producer:recoverability-ranked negotiation payload
handoff:hot/source-edge segments and accepted windows
consumer:source-edge exact global swap plus accepted-window replay/cascade
post_consumer:endpoint/source target repair and optional pair/small-cluster transaction
compatible_with: Blueprint A beside a proven critical-frontier value lane
Blueprint D+A as a separate diamond value lane in multi-student rounds
stacking_notes: Use B as a quality lane when endpoint/source payload is visible; do not infer it only from large improve-stage recovery.
If single-cell endpoint repair is live but flat, stack bounded pair or small-cluster exact transactions over the same frontier.
Keep negotiation as producer; final promotion comes from exact consumer and final HPWL.
done_criteria: Negotiation producer payload is named and nonzero
exact source-edge consumer probes and accepts payload-influenced candidates
final HPWL improves or the missing producer/handoff/consumer link is reported

summary: LEGALM/current-net low-residual producer-consumer stack: keep recoverable LEGALM/full guidance, publish target rows/sites and current-net anchors, build compact row-miss/same-row residual frontier, then consume it with targeted exact global/vertical moves and selected-segment reorder.
use_when: Dense or high-utilization evidence exposes target-miss, low-residual current-net, stage3 anchor, row-miss, or vertical-frontier signals that can be consumed downstream.
avoid_when: Do not use as a generic dense-case default when target/current-net/frontier evidence is absent or when guidance has no consuming legalizer or DPO stage.
mechanism_roles: start_basin:framework
producer:LEGALM/full guidance plus stage3 current-net anchors
handoff:target row/site flags, row-miss cells, same-row residual frontier
consumer:targeted exact global/vertical moves and selected-segment reorder
post_consumer:DPO recoverability preservation and target-miss repair
compatible_with: Blueprint A only if accepted critical frontier becomes live
stacking_notes: Guidance is only a producer unless a primary legalizer or DPO consumer uses the payload.
If producer counters are zero, repair target/frontier criteria before judging C weak.
If consumer counters are zero, route to handoff/DPO import mapping rather than legalizer retuning.
done_criteria: Producer and consumer counters are both nonzero
target/current-net payload affects candidate ranking, exact scoring, or acceptance
final HPWL or failure bucket proves whether C is useful for the current case

summary: Diamond sourceTopK/source-edge exact DPO activation stack: force exact sourceTopK/global-swap lane live, enumerate bounded row/segment/bbox-anchor move probes with swap fallback, exact-score per-source top-K candidates, replay positives through normal accept path, and export accepted-node/hot-segment handoff.
use_when: Diamond/source-edge search is absent, gated off, intensity-zero, or weak, and the assignment explicitly scopes producer activation or a separate exact-DPO value lane.
avoid_when: Do not use as a one-student warm-up when the route also needs immediate consumer proof; assign Blueprint D+A so the Student does not stop before handoff and selected reorder.
mechanism_roles: start_basin:diamond
producer:sourceTopK/source-edge exact DPO activation
handoff:accepted nodes plus old/new hot segments
consumer:selected-segment reorder as minimum immediate consumer when scope allows
post_consumer:Blueprint A continuation after producer evidence
compatible_with: Blueprint D+A when one Student must own the full core chain
Blueprint A continuation after accepted footprint is broad
stacking_notes: Diagnose high exact_scored with zero replay attempts or accepts as producer-quality failure, not a completed chain.
A tiny global ranked-source pool is underbuilt for large row-rich cases; rank per source with bounded top-K.
tryMove is scored before trySwap, with swap as fallback to control runtime.
done_criteria: Exact lane is provably executed with nonzero replay attempts and accepts or a named activation failure
accepted_delta is large enough to justify continuation
next route either consumes the handoff or repairs the named producer-quality/cap issue
